# ELITEA-1992: Build with AI — generated Skill name adheres to naming rules

**Module:** skills · **Priority:** medium · **Type:** functional

**Objective:** Verify that the Skill name generated by the Build with AI feature complies with naming rules: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only; no spaces, underscores, or special characters; no leading or trailing hyphens; max 64 characters.

---

## Preconditions

- User is logged in to the Elitea platform with admin or editor role.
- The Build with AI modal is accessible from the New Skill creation screen.

---

## Test Data

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Natural-language description | Any valid description to trigger generation |

---

## Steps

| # | Action | Expected Result |
|---|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | Open the Build with AI modal and submit a prompt | Generation is initiated and completes successfully |
| 2 | After generation, inspect the generated Name in the review form | The Name field is visible and populated |
| 3 | Verify the name contains only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens | The generated name uses only allowed characters |
| 4 | Verify the name does not contain spaces, underscores, or special characters | No spaces, underscores, or special characters are present |
| 5 | Verify the name does not start or end with a hyphen | The first and last characters are not hyphens |
| 6 | Verify the name does not exceed 64 characters | The name length is 64 characters or fewer |

---

## Expected Final State

The generated Skill name fully conforms to the naming rules: only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; no leading/trailing hyphens; max 64 characters.

---

## Pass/Fail Criteria

**Pass:**
- All steps complete without errors.
- The generated name passes all naming rule checks.

**Fail:**
- Any step produces an error or unexpected result.
- The generated name violates any naming rule (invalid characters, leading/trailing hyphen, exceeds 64 chars).
